# Row-criteria regression

`navigation.bsl` is the exact `ПереходКСтрокеТаблицы` function from pinned Vanessa
Automation commit `f3a01778a14d29b38204685deea0131274d438ff`. Its path, original
line range, Git blob and snippet SHA-256 are recorded in `source.json`. Upstream
license: [BSD 3-Clause](../../../third-party/vanessa-automation/1.2.043.28-itl-r10/LICENSE.upstream).

The Pester owner executes the unchanged function, then applies the relevant hunks
from the shipping patch to that same function and executes it with OneScript.
`field.os`, `table.os`, `server.os` and `vanessa.os` double only the unavailable UI
transport. They expose real display captions, capture dispatch and evaluate all
received criteria together; row-not-found raises an error through the unchanged
adapter error path. The upstream native Structure insertion must fail on
`Дата начала`, while its ordinary identifier case must work in the same fixture.

The fixture proves criteria construction and dispatch/error contracts, not actual
1C UI row movement. Candidate compilation and installed UI acceptance are separate
evidence. OneScript output is explicitly UTF-8 before the test decodes it, and
every probe runs in a path containing both Cyrillic and whitespace.
